en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/381] al-Tawhid: Ibn al-Walid from al-Saffar from Ibn Hashim and Ibn Yazid from Ibn Fadhal from Ibn Bukayr from Zurara from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام
about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: “The Fitra of Allah which He created the people upon” [30:30]. He said: He created them upon Tawhid.
